meta.naming_rule: The translation registry for 433-F. One row per INPUT KEY the 433-F fill engine can consume, saying which HubSpot property feeds it. hs-fetch-433f.mjs reads this file and never re-derives the translation; gen-fields-from-crosswalk.mjs reads it to emit the provisioning definitions for the rows that need creating.
meta.contains: ONLY the properties this form ADDS. The rows the crosswalk classed `exact` bind to properties the backbone already owns and are deliberately not re-declared here — one property with two definition files follows whichever provisioner ran last.
